soldier: Head yellow, the frontal region brown, the anterior ends of the mandibles blackish brown, labrum pale yellow, anteclypeus white; the flanges over the antennal sockets and antennal segments 1 to 3 brown, becoming paler segment by segment towards the apex. Except for the darker margins of the pronotum, the rest of the body is pale yellowish white in varying tones, the abdomen especially pale.
